title: Missing optional lint data breaks both quality charts
reasoning: The evolution page explicitly supports checkpoint data without lint_errors, but the quality page unconditionally selects that column. For the same supported dataset, this raises KeyError before either figure is returned, also preventing the available complexity comparison from rendering.
reproduction: Supply checkpoints for both selected runs with problem, idx, cc_high_count and metadata, but no lint_errors column, then invoke update_quality.
recommendation: Check metric availability before selecting columns and return an unavailable or empty figure for missing lint data while rendering the complexity comparison.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; the supplied evidence contains no coverage of optional metric availability across pages.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise the quality callback with optional metrics present and absent, asserting that unavailable metrics do not prevent available comparisons from rendering.
